note: Boyle's law (GAME_SPEC §6 Pistons, §13.7, Stage 79; docs/CURRICULUM.md, experiment 27): a 100 mL glass gas syringe of 100 mL of air at 20 C, its nozzle capped. Pushed in and locked at 100, 80 and 60 mL, its pressure read at each: P V stands (the dead volume under its scale, 0.57 mL, with it). A hand pushes with at most 79.8 N: about 52 mL is as far as it goes.
